cards.text: Solomon, king of Israel, has more riches and wisdom than any king on earth, and he made silver as common in Jerusalem as STONES, friend (1 Kings 10:23, 27). Then comes one little word that changes everything: "however."

cards.question: Solomon has the riches and the wisdom. What does the text say King Solomon loves?

cards.text: Along with the daughter of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, there are women of Moab, Ammon, Edom and Sidon, plus Hittite women. Friend, that's not a guest list, that's a MAP.

cards.question: The LORD had already told the Israelites something about these nations: You must not ___ with them.
The LORD had warned that these nations would surely turn the Israelites' hearts after their gods.

cards.text: Even with that warning, Solomon clings to these women in love.
Now the numbers: seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines. Friend, I lose track of ONE timer in my own bakery, and this man has seven HUNDRED anniversaries.

cards.question: When Solomon grows old, his wives turn his heart after other gods. He isn't wholeheartedly devoted to the LORD the way his father ___ had been.

cards.text: And the text gets specific. Solomon follows Ashtoreth, the goddess of the Sidonians, and Milcom, the abomination of the Ammonites.

cards.question: Solomon is following Ashtoreth and Milcom. How does the text sum up what he's doing?

answers.text: He did evil in the sight of the LORD
He made peace in the sight of the nations
He did justice in the sight of his people

cards.text: At that time, Solomon starts building on a hill east of Jerusalem.

cards.question: What does Solomon build on that hill east of Jerusalem?

answers.text: A high place for gods of Moab and Ammon
A storehouse for his gold and ivory
A stable for his horses and chariots

cards.text: That high place is for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, and Molech, the abomination of the Ammonites.

cards.question: Solomon builds high places only for the gods of Moab and Ammon, and not for his other foreign wives.

cards.text: His foreign wives burn incense and sacrifice to their gods. And now the LORD grows angry with Solomon.

cards.question: Why does the LORD grow angry with Solomon?

answers.text: His heart had turned away from the LORD
He had spent too much of Israel's gold
He had grown too proud of his throne

cards.question: This is the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to Solomon ___.

cards.text: An angel showed up at the junk drawer I was stuck in ONE time, and I'm still telling everybody about it. And the God who appeared to Solomon had warned him plainly not to follow other gods.
Solomon didn't keep that command. Then the LORD speaks to him: because Solomon hasn't kept His covenant and His statutes, something is coming.

cards.question: The LORD tells Solomon He will tear the ___ away from him.
Who will the LORD give the kingdom to once He tears it away from Solomon?

cards.text: But the LORD isn't finished speaking. Next He tells Solomon when this tearing will happen.

cards.question: For David's sake, the LORD says He won't tear the kingdom away during Solomon's lifetime.

cards.text: Instead, He'll tear it out of the hand of Solomon's son. And even then, He won't take the whole thing.

cards.question: How many tribes will the LORD give to Solomon's son?
The LORD leaves Solomon's son that tribe for the sake of His servant David and for the sake of ___, the city He has chosen.

cards.text: I'm sliding this batch onto the rack for now, friend. But this kingdom's story is only getting warmed up.
